description: Derived from AGSC-05-38 (f) and (g): every property of the site vocabulary is a sub-property of a link property and declares no domain or range. `dom:floats` specialises none, and `dom:rooted` declares `rdfs:domain` (a constraint on where a property may be used is an invariant, AGSC-05-41). Each is one error AGSC-E420 on the vocabulary file.
